system.description:
Built on Project FU's Improviser.

MOUNTEBANK SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000282]{Ready Hands} 【Max SL 2】

Whenever you spend a Fabula Point in a conflict, gain 2 IP as well.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000283]{Field Improvisation} 【Max SL 2】

As an action, produce two Inventory-tier items simultaneously. Their effects both apply (or both activate on a target of your choice).

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000284]{Patter} 【Max SL 3】

When you try to fill or erase a clock through deception or comic misdirection, roll 1d3. Optionally apply that result as a bonus or penalty to your check — your choice after seeing the die.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000285]{Whoops!}

Declare any check a deliberate fumble before rolling. The fumble triggers normally (Opportunity for the GM, FP earned for you). You additionally choose which Opportunity the GM takes (from a list you agree on). An ally of your choice immediately recovers 10 MP.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000286]{Witty Remark} 【Max SL 3】

Spend (SL × 5) MP. A creature that can hear you takes −(SL) to its next check this round.
